description: Public WLAN Standorte Wien is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.wien.gv.at. The locations of the vienna.at public Wi-Fi routers are provided. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Public Wi-Fi locations Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WIFI, Öffentliches WLAN, ViennaGIS, Public WLAN, WLAN, wien.at WLAN. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, SHP, KMZ, JPEG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
